title: Benowitz's drawings of an alien craft flown by the US government
summary: Greg Bishop tells of Benowitz's drawings of an alien craft flown by the US government, about early 1980s at New Mexico (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he said it was a a craft that the aliens had gave given to the United States government and the government was flying it and they didn't know how to do it and it crashed.

plain: A writer and researcher named Greg Bishop told podcast host Jesse Michels about drawings made in the early 1980s by Paul Bennewitz, a man in New Mexico, linked to a document called Project Beta and to a place called Archuleta Mesa. According to Bishop, Bennewitz said the drawings showed a craft that aliens had given to the US government, which flew it without really knowing how, and it crashed. If true, it would mean the government was flying alien hardware.
